news.title: Why Xabi Alonso wants 'busy weeks' in his Chelsea future
news.title_zh: 为什么哈维·阿隆索希望在切尔西的未来有“忙碌的几周”
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso and his Chelsea players have had seven days to prepare for today's trip to Sunderland. However, the Blues manager does not want that luxury next season. With no European football on our agenda this term, Alonso has enjoyed more quality time with his squad on the training pitches at Cobham during the opening months of his tenure. That has been important for the Spaniard, who is still embedding his tactical principles and forging close bonds with his players. He has overseen a largely positive start to the campaign, with the Blues fourth in the top flight having taken 16 points from our opening nine fixtures. Our tenth takes place this afternoon as we travel to Sunderland, who, in contrast to the Blues, are competing in European football for the first time in more than 50 years. That comes with its own pressures and a more punishing schedule. Yet it's one Alonso wants  – and one he insists he and his players are working toward. 'The ambition is to be back there [in Europe],' the Blues manager explained during his pre-match press conference. '[We want it] to be just one season that we are having long weeks. The aim, the desire, the hunger is to have busy weeks, to have to deal with three games a week, and that we'll see each other much more. 'It's not that it hurts now, because you deal with it, but this is where we want to be.' As a two-time Champions League winner and someone who made 119 appearances in the competition during his playing career, Alonso is well-versed in the demands that come with performing at the top table of European football. He wants Chelsea to be back on that stage, but appreciates that only comes through hard work and consistency in the months ahead. 'We want to be playing in Europe, in big stadiums, having top teams in Europe because I think that we can be there, but we need to earn it to be there. 'We like football and, unfortunately, we can only comment [on what has taken place during a European gameweek]. The feeling is that we want to be there, but we need to deserve that.'
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索和他的切尔西球员有 7 天的时间为今天对阵桑德兰的比赛做准备。然而，蓝军主帅下赛季并不想要这种奢侈。由于本学期没有欧洲足球比赛，阿隆索在上任的头几个月里与他的球队在科巴姆的训练场上享受了更多的优质时光。这对于西班牙人来说非常重要，他仍然坚持自己的战术原则并与球员建立密切的联系。在他的带领下，蓝军在本赛季取得了良好的开局，在顶级联赛中排名第四，在前九场比赛中拿下了 16 分。我们的第十场比赛将于今天下午前往桑德兰举行，与蓝军不同，桑德兰是 50 多年来首次参加欧洲足球比赛。这也带来了自身的压力和更加严峻的赛程安排。但这正是阿隆索想要的——而且他坚称他和他的球员正在为之努力。 “我们的目标是回到欧洲，”蓝军主帅在赛前新闻发布会上解释道。 “[我们希望]这只是我们度过漫长几周的一个赛季。我们的目标、愿望和渴望是度过忙碌的几周，每周应对三场比赛，并且我们会更多地见面。 “现在并不痛苦，因为你要应对它，但这就是我们想要的地方。”作为两届欧洲冠军联赛冠军以及在职业生涯中出场 119 次的阿隆索，深知在欧洲足球顶级联赛中表现的要求。他希望切尔西能够回到那个舞台，但他很感激这只能通过未来几个月的努力和坚持来实现。 “我们希望在欧洲的大型体育场踢球，拥有欧洲顶级球队，因为我认为我们可以到达那里，但我们需要赢得它才能到达那里。 “我们喜欢足球，不幸的是，我们只能评论[欧洲比赛周期间发生的事情]。感觉是我们想要在那里，但我们需要配得上它。

news.title: Opposition scout – Sunderland
news.title_zh: 反对派球探 - 桑德兰
news.body_en: Ahead of Chelsea's Premier League meeting with Sunderland, we take a closer look at the Black Cats, their approach under Regis Le Bris and the players who could make an impact. The Black Cats are 12 points shy of last season’s tally at the same stage, having scored four fewer goals and conceded ten more. While many of their metrics are comparable to last season, Regis Le Bris’s team have been affected by individual errors, with three of their players having made mistakes that twice led to goals. Le Bris, who joined the Wearsiders from French club Lorient in 2024, has maintained a consistent line-up from last season despite plenty of investment over recent transfer windows. Nine of Sunderland’s starters in the 3-0 loss to Coventry last weekend began the match in May at Stamford Bridge that clinched their first European foray since 1973 at Chelsea’s expense. The Frenchman has handled Sunderland’s busy schedule by making substantial changes in cup games at home and abroad. The workload may also explain a more measured approach to high pressing – they have not scored from a high turnover this season. The manager will be forced into at least one change in central defence, as Luke O’Nien’s partner Omar Alderete is suspended after receiving a second yellow card in the last minute at Coventry. Le Bris has stuck with the midfield pivot of Granit Xhaka, now 34, and Noah Sadiki, and often prefers full-backs such as Trai Hume or Thomas Meunier on the wings over the likes of summer signings Jocelin Ta Bi and Malick Fofana. Lone striker and leading marksman Brian Brobbey has accounted for three of Sunderland’s seven league goals, one ahead of No.10 Enzo Le Fee. Centre-back Dan Ballard, midfielder Habib Diarra and winger Romaine Mundle are injured, but left-back Nordi Mukiele and teenage striker Juan Riquelme Angulo could return to readiness.
news.body_zh: 在切尔西对阵桑德兰的英超联赛之前，我们仔细研究了黑猫队、他们在雷吉斯·勒布里斯的带领下的表现以及可能产生影响的球员。 The Black Cats are 12 points shy of last season’s tally at the same stage, having scored four fewer goals and conceded ten more.虽然他们的许多指标与上赛季相当，但雷吉斯·勒布里斯的球队受到了个人错误的影响，他们的三名球员曾两次犯下导致进球的错误。勒布里斯于 2024 年从法国洛里昂俱乐部加盟韦赛德，尽管在最近的转会窗口进行了大量投资，但他仍保持了上赛季的阵容稳定。上周末 0-3 输给考文垂的比赛中，桑德兰队的 9 名首发球员于 5 月份在斯坦福桥开始了比赛，这场比赛是他们自 1973 年以来首次进军欧洲赛场，但切尔西队却被淘汰。 The Frenchman has handled Sunderland’s busy schedule by making substantial changes in cup games at home and abroad. The workload may also explain a more measured approach to high pressing – they have not scored from a high turnover this season.主教练将被迫至少对中卫进行一次调整，卢克·奥尼恩的搭档奥马尔·阿尔德雷特在对阵考文垂的最后一分钟吃到第二张黄牌后停赛。勒布里斯一直坚持以现年34岁的格拉尼特·扎卡和诺阿·萨迪基为中场核心，并且经常更喜欢边后卫，如特拉伊·休姆或托马斯·穆尼耶，而不是夏季签约的乔赛林·塔比和马利克·福法纳等边后卫。 Lone striker and leading marksman Brian Brobbey has accounted for three of Sunderland’s seven league goals, one ahead of No.10 Enzo Le Fee.中后卫丹·巴拉德、中场球员哈比卜·迪亚拉和边锋罗曼·蒙德尔受伤，但左后卫诺迪·穆基勒和青少年前锋胡安·里克尔梅·安古洛可能会恢复状态。

news.title: OTD: Gianfranco Zola joins Chelsea - watch all his goals!
news.title_zh: OTD：吉安弗兰科·佐拉加盟切尔西 - 观看他的所有进球！
news.body_en: It was on this day in 1996, precisely 30 years ago now, that the Blues completed the signing of Gianfranco Zola, who over seven seasons at Stamford Bridge stole the hearts of Chelsea fans everywhere. He helped win four trophies and scored the winner in the 1998 European Cup Winners' Cup final just seconds after coming on as substitute. In all, Franco scored 80 goals in 312 games, with many of them being spectacular efforts. You can watch the lot below!Goals that will live long in the memory include a mid-air back-flick against Norwich City, an effort against Manchester United that left opposition goalkeeper Peter Schmeichel motionless and a brilliant turn and shot in a 1997 FA Cup semi-final win over Wimbledon. Above all, Franco always played football as if he enjoyed it and was almost universally popular amongst opposition fans.Zola did suffer a dip in form during the 2001/02 season but returned strongly the following season, scoring 16 times as we qualified for the Champions League. He scored his last goal for Chelsea on Easter Monday 2003 and in his final appearance came on for the last 20 minutes of a win over Liverpool that saw us claim fourth place and with it, Champions League qualification. It was a truly fitting finale to a glorious Chelsea career.
news.body_zh: 正是在 1996 年的今天，也就是 30 年前，蓝军完成了对詹弗兰科·佐拉的签约，他在斯坦福桥度过了七个多赛季，俘获了各地切尔西球迷的心。他帮助赢得了四座奖杯，并在 1998 年欧洲优胜者杯决赛中替补上场数秒后攻入制胜球。弗朗哥总共在 312 场比赛中打进了 80 个进球，其中许多进球都是令人惊叹的。您可以在下面观看很多精彩进球！这些进球将长久地留在人们的记忆中，包括对阵诺维奇城的空中后弹、对阵曼联的一脚射门，让对手门将彼得·舒梅切尔一动不动，以及 1997 年足总杯半决赛战胜温布尔登的精彩转身射门。最重要的是，佛朗哥踢球时总是表现得好像他很享受足球一样，并且几乎受到了对手球迷的普遍欢迎。佐拉在2001/02赛季的状态确实有所下滑，但在接下来的赛季强势回归，攻入16球，帮助我们获得了欧冠资格。 2003 年复活节星期一，他为切尔西打入最后一个进球，并在最后 20 分钟出场，帮助切尔西战胜利物浦，帮助我们获得第四名并获得欧冠资格。这是辉煌的切尔西职业生涯真正恰当的结局。

news.title: Gianfranco Zola’s greatest moments in Blue
news.title_zh: 詹弗兰科·佐拉在蓝色时期最伟大的时刻
news.body_en: Gianfranco Zola is, quite simply, one of Chelsea’s very best. On the 30th anniversary of his signing, what better time to relive Zola’s glorious career in west London. The Italian magician arrived from Parma on 8 November 1996 and left nearly seven years later as an all-time great, his place in our history books cemented by a catalogue of indelible moments. Narrowing them down to a shortlist is no easy feat – anybody who had the good fortune of watching Zola play for us will call to mind different memories of his genius. But here are 11 moments, in chronological order, that we think stand out above the rest... Zola’s first Chelsea goal was a sign of things to come. Standing over a free-kick 35 yards out, few would have given him a chance of finding the net – but we didn’t know then quite how capable he was from set-pieces. His strike had whip and dip, leaving Everton’s keeper Neville Southall and a defender who had hastily retreated to the line in a spin, and Chelsea mouths agape. A fortnight later Zola’s ingenuity again left Stamford Bridge in awe. This time he was released down the right-hand channel before turning grizzled West Ham full-back Julian Dicks inside and out and firing home with aplomb. 'I didn't know who Julian Dicks was at that point,' Gianfranco joked years later. 'Probably if I had known maybe I wouldn't have done that as it was too dangerous!' Few made the great Manchester United team of the nineties and noughties look as silly as Zola did in just the second minute of a February ’97 Premier League meeting. He first cut inside the sliding Dennis Irwin before easing past Gary Pallister, left imbalanced by Zola’s delicate touch. The finish that followed was emphatic, fired past the rooted Peter Schmeichel at his near post. Not even six months into his Chelsea career and Zola had already accumulated an enviable collection of wonder goals. Arguably none topped his dazzling effort in the FA Cup semi-final win over Wimbledon at Highbury. Running adjacent to the goal, Zola collected a pass from Roberto Di Matteo and with his first touch somehow flicked it back in the opposite direction and into his path as he shifted his weight. One more touch and then bang – the ball was in the Wimbledon net! Zola’s debut season in England captured the attention of fans and pundits alike, to the extent the country’s journalists voted him as their Football Writers’ Association Footballer of the Year by a distance – Zola polled twice the number of votes gained by Juninho and our own Mark Hughes. It was a season in which he also scored the winning goal for Italy against England at Wembley. Our first piece of major silverware in a generation was secured when Eddie Newton forced the ball home from close range late on in our FA Cup final triumph against Middlesbrough at Wembley. The goal owed much to the majesty of Zola, who deftly flicked Dan Petrescu’s cross back into the six-yard box for Newton to convert. Zola’s most famous Chelsea goal arrived scarcely 20 seconds after he had entered the action in the 1998 Cup Winners’ Cup final. He wasted no time making an impact, latching on a Dennis Wise pass and thrashing the ball high into the roof of the net. It was his most famous Chelsea goal and it won us the Cup Winners’ Cup. Our first ever Champions League quarter-final tie paired us with the might of Barcelona. Zola inspired an extraordinary performance with a trademark free-kick that dipped over the wall and into the Shed End net. We were 3-0 up by the break at an ecstatic Stamford Bridge in what will go down as one of Chelsea’s greatest halves of football ever. Not many goals leave people speechless, but Zola managed just that in an FA Cup tie against Norwich in 2002. He met Graeme Le Saux’s low corner on the full with a backflicked volley that fizzed past Rob Green in a flash. It wasn’t until the replay was shown on the big screen at Stamford Bridge that the audacity and execution of the finish was evident. Zola finished as he started. Just as his first Chelsea goal had the Bridge faithful in awe, so did his last. With Chelsea cruising against Everton in our quest to finish in the top four, Zola raced down the left and, from an improbable angle, lofted the bouncing ball over Richard Wright in the Everton goal. It was the kind of moment of magic Zola had deservedly earned a reputation as producing on a regular basis. Zola’s final game for the Blues was a huge one as we hosted Liverpool at the Bridge with the final spot in the Champions League places up for grabs. We led 2-1 when Zola came off the bench and, with time ticking down, danced between a gaggle of red shirts, including a bewildered Jamie Carragher, in a clip that has stood the test of time to go viral in the modern age. It epitomised his genius. When Zola met Carragher... ✨ pic.twitter.com/3Dpxv9VSIE
news.body_zh: 简单地说，詹弗兰科·佐拉是切尔西最好的球员之一。在签约 30 周年之际，正是重温佐拉在伦敦西部辉煌职业生涯的最佳时机。这位意大利魔术师于 1996 年 11 月 8 日从帕尔马抵达，并在近七年后离开，成为历史上的伟大人物，一系列不可磨灭的时刻巩固了他在我们历史书中的地位。将他们缩小到候选名单并不是一件容易的事——任何有幸观看佐拉为我们比赛的人都会唤起对他天才的不同回忆。但按照时间顺序，这里有 11 个我们认为最突出的时刻……佐拉在切尔西的第一个进球预示着即将发生的事情。站在 35 码外的任意球面前，很少有人会给他机会破门——但当时我们并不知道他在定位球方面的能力有多大。他的射门充满了鞭子和倾斜，使得埃弗顿的门将内维尔·索撒尔和一名后卫在旋转中匆忙撤退到罚球线上，切尔西张大了嘴。两周后，佐拉的独创性再次让斯坦福桥惊叹不已。这一次，他从右路被释放，然后将头发花白的西汉姆联后卫朱利安·迪克斯从里到外，沉着地射门。 “当时我不知道朱利安·迪克斯是谁，”几年后吉安弗兰科开玩笑说。 “如果我知道的话，我可能就不会那么做了，因为这太危险了！”很少有人能像佐拉在 97 年 2 月英超联赛比赛的第二分钟那样让这支上世纪九十年代伟大的曼联队看起来如此愚蠢。他首先切入滑动的丹尼斯·欧文，然后轻松越过加里·帕利斯特，佐拉微妙的触球使他失去了平衡。随后的射门非常有力，射门越过近门柱处的彼得·舒梅切尔。佐拉在切尔西的职业生涯还不到六个月，就已经积累了一系列令人羡慕的精彩进球。可以说，没有人能比他在海布里击败温布尔登的足总杯半决赛中表现出色的表现更出色。佐拉在球门附近跑动，接到罗伯托·迪马特奥的传球，他的第一次触球不知何故将球弹回了相反的方向，并在他转移体重时回到了他的路径上。再触碰一下，然后砰地一声——球进了温网！佐拉在英格兰的首个赛季吸引了球迷和专家的关注，以至于该国的记者将他远远地选为足球作家协会年度最佳球员——佐拉的得票数是儒尼尼奥和我们自己的马克·休斯的两倍。那个赛季，他还为意大利队在温布利对阵英格兰队的比赛中攻入致胜进球。我们在温布利战胜米德尔斯堡的足总杯决赛中，埃迪·牛顿近距离将球射入球门，我们获得了一代人以来的第一座重要奖杯。这个进球很大程度上要归功于佐拉的威严，他巧妙地将丹·佩特雷斯库的传中弹回六码禁区内，让牛顿将球射入。佐拉最著名的切尔西进球是在 1998 年优胜者杯决赛上场后不到 20 秒就打进的。他不失时机地发起冲击，接住丹尼斯·怀斯的传球，将球高高打入网顶。这是他最著名的切尔西进球，帮助我们赢得了优胜者杯。我们的第一次欧冠四分之一决赛让我们与巴塞罗那的实力相媲美。佐拉凭借一记标志性的任意球激发了一场非凡的表演，该球越过人墙落入谢德恩德的球网。中场休息时，我们在欣喜若狂的斯坦福桥以 3-0 领先，这将成为切尔西足球史上最伟大的半场之一。没有多少进球让人哑口无言，但佐拉在 2002 年足总杯对阵诺维奇的比赛中做到了这一点。他在全场接格雷姆·勒索克斯的低角，一记后弹凌空抽射过了罗布·格林。直到斯坦福桥大屏幕上重播时，比赛的大胆和执行力才得以显现。佐拉开始时也结束了。正如他在切尔西的第一个进球让蓝桥球迷惊叹不已，他的最后一个进球也是如此。当切尔西在对阵埃弗顿的比赛中力争进入前四名时，佐拉从左路冲下，从一个不可思议的角度将弹起的皮球越过埃弗顿球门的理查德·赖特。正是这种神奇的时刻，佐拉当之无愧地赢得了定期产出的声誉。 佐拉为蓝军的最后一场比赛是一场重要的比赛，我们在桥上迎战利物浦，欧冠最后一个席位有待争夺。当佐拉替补出场时，我们以2-1领先，随着时间的流逝，他在一群红衫军之间跳舞，其中包括困惑的杰米·卡拉格，这段视频经受了时间的考验，在现代迅速走红。这集中体现了他的天才。当佐拉遇见卡拉格......✨ pic.twitter.com/3Dpxv9VSIE

news.title: Five of Chelsea's most memorable moments against Sunderland
news.title_zh: 切尔西对阵桑德兰最难忘的五个时刻
news.body_en: Sunderland may have only been an opponent of ours in just over half of the Premier League seasons to date, but the Black Cats have been on the receiving end of some iconic Chelsea moments. We first played Sunderland in the Premier League in 1996/97, recording a memorable 6-2 victory at Stamford Bridge. Since then, there have been goals, performances and top-flight title celebrations that will live long in the memory. Here we bring you the top five… Chelsea 4-0 Sunderland7 August 1999 The sun was shining at Stamford Bridge as Chelsea, tipped for the title by some, started the new season in style by sinking newly-promoted Sunderland. Gus Poyet, Gianfranco Zola and Tore Andre Flo had already given us an unassailable lead when Poyet bagged the goal of the game. Zola scooped the ball over the Mackems’ defence and into the path of Poyet, who expertly scissor-kicked his volley into the top corner. In creation and execution, it was simply sublime. Chelsea 7-2 Sunderland16 January 2010 In a season full of goals, Ashley Cole’s against Sunderland at the turn of the year was voted by supporters as the best, and it was easy to see why. From inside his own half, John Terry put a lofted first-time pass into the path of the marauding left-back. Running at full tilt didn’t stop Cole bringing the ball under his spell with an immaculate first touch. As Sunderland skipper Lorik Cana slid across to block the shot, Cole calmly cut the ball inside him before using the outside of his left boot to find the far corner. Sunderland 3-4 Chelsea4 December 2013 Singling out one Eden Hazard performance for Chelsea is no easy task, but his display at the Stadium of Light in December 2013 arguably stands above the rest. After providing an assist for Frank Lampard, Hazard netted two individual goals of the highest quality to help us to a 4-3 win. His second goal, again after combining with Lampard, was particularly magical. He instinctively and ecstatically ripped off his shirt in celebration, a sure sign even the cool Belgian was impressed by his masterclass on Wearside. Chelsea 3-1 Sunderland24 May 2015 Both of our most recent Premier League trophy lifts have come after final-day victories over Sunderland at Stamford Bridge. The first was in May 2015, when a penalty from Diego Costa and a Loic Remy brace secured a 3-1 success after we had gone behind early. One of the many highlights that day was the sight of Didier Drogba being carried off the pitch by his team-mates after his final Chelsea appearance. History would repeat itself two years later… Chelsea 5-1 SunderlandMay 21 2017 On that occasion, it was John Terry who was celebrated off the Stamford Bridge turf 26 minutes into his final game, which would prove a resounding victory over the relegated Black Cats. Again, we went behind. Again, we hit back in style. Willian levelled with an angle finish before goals from Eden Hazard and Pedro, two of the stars of the season, had us in control as the contest drew to a close. Michy Batshuayi, whose goal at West Brom a week earlier secured the title, added a late double as the celebrations started in earnest once more.
news.body_zh: 迄今为止，桑德兰可能只在半个多半的英超赛季中成为我们的对手，但黑猫队却成为了切尔西的一些标志性时刻的接受者。我们第一次在英超联赛中对阵桑德兰是在 1996/97 赛季，当时我们在斯坦福桥以 6-2 取得了令人难忘的胜利。从那时起，我们的进球、表现和顶级联赛冠军庆祝活动将永远留在人们的记忆中。在此，我们为您带来前五名…… 切尔西 4-0 桑德兰 1999 年 8 月7 日 斯坦福桥阳光明媚，一些人认为切尔西将夺冠，但他们却以击败升班马桑德兰的方式华丽地开始了新赛季。当波耶特攻入本场比赛的进球时，格斯·波耶特、吉安弗兰科·佐拉和托雷·安德烈·弗洛已经为我们带来了无懈可击的领先优势。佐拉将球越过麦克姆斯的防守，传到波耶特的路径上，波耶特熟练地用剪刀脚将球射入球门上角。在创作和执行上，它简直是崇高的。切尔西 7-2 桑德兰 2010 年 1 月 16 日 在一个充满进球的赛季中，阿什利·科尔在岁末年初对阵桑德兰的比赛被球迷票选为最佳进球，原因显而易见。约翰·特里在本方半场内首次将一记高高传球传给了这位掠夺性的左后卫。全速奔跑并没有阻止科尔以完美的第一次触球将球带入他的魔力之中。当桑德兰队队长洛里克·卡纳横身挡出射门时，科尔冷静地将球内切，然后用左靴外侧找到远角。桑德兰 3-4 切尔西 2013 年 12 月4 日 切尔西队中挑出阿扎尔的表现绝非易事，但他在 2013 年 12 月在光明球场的表现可以说是遥遥领先。在为弗兰克·兰帕德送出助攻后，阿扎尔打进了两个最高质量的个人进球，帮助我们以4-3获胜。他的第二个进球，再次与兰帕德联手后，特别神奇。他本能地、欣喜若狂地脱掉衬衫以示庆祝，这无疑表明即使是这位冷静的比利时人也对他在威尔赛德的大师班印象深刻。切尔西 3-1 桑德兰 2015 年 5 月 24 日 我们最近两次捧起英超奖杯都是在斯坦福桥最后一天战胜桑德兰之后取得的。第一次是在2015年5月，当时我们早早落后，迭戈·科斯塔的点球和卢伊克·雷米的梅开二度帮助球队以3-1获胜。那天的众多亮点之一是迪迪埃·德罗巴在切尔西最后一次出场后被队友抬出球场。两年后历史将重演……切尔西 5-1 桑德兰 2017 年 5 月 21 日在那场比赛中，约翰·特里在他的最后一场比赛进行到第 26 分钟时在斯坦福桥草坪上庆祝，这将证明这是对降级黑猫队的一场彻底胜利。我们又落后了。我们再次以时尚的方式反击。威廉以角度射门扳平比分，随后本赛季的两位球星阿扎尔和佩德罗的进球让我们控制了比赛，比赛接近尾声。米奇·巴舒亚伊一周前在西布朗队的进球确保了冠军头衔，在庆祝活动再次正式开始时，他在比赛最后时刻打进了两粒进球。

news.title: Erin Cuthbert: 'There will be a reaction'
news.title_zh: 艾琳·卡斯伯特：“会有反应”
news.body_en: Chelsea captain Erin Cuthbert reflected on a disappointing stalemate against Everton on Saturday afternoon, but vowed the side would bounce back against Hacken in the Women's Champions League on Tuesday. The skipper started the match for only the second time this season after recovering from a knee injury sustained in the summer and was substituted for Aggie Beever-Jones after 74 minutes with the Blues chasing a goal. Despite our best efforts, it was not to be, and Cuthbert gave her thoughts after the final whistle. She said: 'We did really well at getting ourselves ahead in the first half. That’s been our target: to score early, and then we conceded an unfortunate goal, which is no one’s fault. But we need to do a little bit more. 'We weren’t quite on the same page today defensively. We weren’t pressing as a group, as we have done in the previous games. We were a bit sloppy on the ball, too. 'But I can’t fault anybody’s effort. The effort has been there. It’s just one of those days where we were really not at it, and we can’t have too many of those if we want to be in a title race.' The teams went in with the scores at 1-1 during the interval after a Lucy Bronze own goal had cancelled out Sandy Baltimore's opener. Everton could then afford to sit back during the second half, meaning Chelsea were stuck trying to find a winner. 'You can’t get too stressed,' Cuthbert explained. 'I feel like as players we tend to look at scoreboards and things start to slip away. But you’ll always get a chance, and we had a few half-chances here and there today. We were dangerous on set pieces. We obviously scored from Katie's (McCabe) cross as well. 'But you have games where you just grind out results. You don’t always have to be at your best throughout the whole season, as long as you’re getting the results. But we didn’t have that today, and we can’t have too many more of those.' There is very little time for the team to linger over today's result, with a trip to Sweden on the horizon and a game against Hacken on Tuesday night. As captain, Cuthbert will take responsibility for lifting the spirits and making sure we are ready for that challenge, before returning to Stamford Bridge to face Manchester City next weekend. 'There’s going to be a reaction, for sure,' she said. 'There’s a lot of unhappy people in the dressing room, and rightly so, because this is a club that expects to win games of football. But just the quality was lacking for us today, myself included. If we all looked at ourselves in the dressing room, we all know that we could have done a lot better today. 'I’m sure that we’ll be back at training tomorrow, ready and fully focused on Hacken. We will make sure that we put our best foot forward come Tuesday night.'
news.body_zh: 切尔西队长艾琳·库斯伯特回顾了周六下午对阵埃弗顿的令人失望的平局，但发誓球队将在周二的女子冠军联赛中对阵哈肯。这位队长在从夏天的膝伤中恢复后，本赛季仅第二次首发出场，并在第 74 分钟蓝军追平比分时被阿吉·比弗-琼斯替换下场。尽管我们尽了最大努力，但事实并非如此，库斯伯特在终场哨响后表达了她的想法。她说：“我们在上半场取得领先方面做得非常好。这一直是我们的目标：尽早进球，然后我们不幸失球，这不是任何人的错。但我们还需要做更多的事情。 “今天我们在防守上并没有达成一致。我们没有像前几场比赛那样作为一个整体进行压迫。我们对球也有点马虎。 “但我不能责怪任何人的努力。努力已经在那里了。这只是我们真的没有参加的那些日子之一，如果我们想参加冠军争夺战，我们就不能有太多这样的日子。中场休息时，露西·青铜的乌龙球抵消了桑迪·巴尔的摩的首开纪录，两队以 1-1 的比分进入比赛。埃弗顿在下半场可以袖手旁观，这意味着切尔西陷入了寻找胜利者的困境。 “你不能压力太大，”卡斯伯特解释道。 “我觉得作为球员，我们倾向于看记分牌，但事情开始溜走。但你总会有机会的，今天我们到处都有一些半机会。我们在定位球上很危险。显然我们也从凯蒂（麦凯布）的传中得分。 “但有些游戏只是磨出结果。只要你取得了成果，你不必在整个赛季中始终保持最佳状态。但我们今天没有这样的东西，而且我们也不能再有太多这样的东西了。”球队几乎没有时间去思考今天的结果，即将前往瑞典并在周二晚上对阵哈肯的比赛。作为队长，卡斯伯特将负责振奋精神并确保我们为迎接挑战做好准备，然后下周末返回斯坦福桥对阵曼城。 “肯定会有反应，”她说。 “更衣室里有很多不高兴的人，这是正确的，因为这是一家希望赢得足球比赛的俱乐部。但今天的我们，包括我自己，都缺乏质量。如果我们都在更衣室里审视自己，我们都知道我们今天可以做得更好。 “我确信我们明天会回到训练场，做好准备并完全专注于哈肯。我们将确保周二晚上尽最大努力。”

news.title: Alonso on Lavia’s ‘brain for the team’ and his next step
news.title_zh: 阿隆索谈拉维亚的“团队大脑”和他的下一步
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has emphasised Romeo Lavia's growing importance in his Chelsea side, highlighting the midfielder's recent development while insisting there is still more to come. Lavia was excellent in our previous two matches, against Liverpool and Manchester United, with the added bonus that he completed the 90 minutes in both. It has reinforced the belief that Lavia is establishing himself as a key controller in the heart of our midfield, and that consistency and rhythm is something Alonso knows from personal experience will only help his team. ‘I always have the feeling that every time the midfield area works, the team works better,’ Alonso said. ‘Romeo is in a very good place, not just the last game. I think that for the last month he's been very consistent in his performance. ‘He's been very important for the team because in the middle you need to have a brain for yourself, but a brain for the team. He's good with the ball, he's giving balance, and he's connecting really well with the players around him. ‘It's not rocket science to know that once you have good midfielders, the team normally looks better.’ Despite Lavia’s eye-catching displays, our manager has made it clear he will continue to demand higher standards from the Belgian international to ensure his ceiling is reached. He said: ‘We need to push him. We need to help him continue so he can take the next step, because it’s not enough yet. ‘There's been a change, and he knows that,’ added Alonso when asked if Lavia is doing anything differently. ‘He has realised that's the way.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索强调了罗密欧·拉维亚在切尔西队中日益重要的地位，强调了这位中场球员最近的发展，同时坚称还有更多的进步。拉维亚在我们之前对阵利物浦和曼联的两场比赛中表现出色，而且他在两场比赛中都踢满了 90 分钟。这增强了人们的信念，拉维亚正在将自己打造成我们中场核心的关键控制者，而阿隆索从个人经验中知道，一致性和节奏只会对他的球队有所帮助。 “我总有一种感觉，每当中场区域发挥作用时，球队就会表现得更好，”阿隆索说。 “罗密欧处于一个非常好的位置，而不仅仅是最后一场比赛。我认为上个月他的表现非常稳定。 “他对球队非常重要，因为在中间你需要有自己的大脑，但也有球队的大脑。他控球能力很好，能够保持平衡，并且与周围的球员联系得很好。 “知道一旦拥有优秀的中场球员，球队通常会看起来更好，这并不是火箭科学。”尽管拉维亚表现出色，但我们的主教练已明确表示，他将继续对这位比利时国脚提出更高的标准，以确保达到他的上限。他说：‘我们需要推动他。我们需要帮助他继续前进，以便他可以采取下一步，因为这还不够。当被问及拉维亚是否做了任何不同的事情时，阿隆索补充道，“发生了变化，他知道这一点。” “他已经意识到就是这样。”

news.title: Frustrated Bompastor: 'We were not clinical or ruthless enough'
news.title_zh: 沮丧的邦帕斯特：“我们不够冷静或不够冷酷”
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor was left feeling frustrated by our 1-1 draw with Everton at Stamford Bridge on Saturday afternoon, but felt it was an opportunity to reflect and improve before Tuesday night's Women's Champions League trip to Hacken in Sweden. The head coach said in her pre-match press conference the Toffees would be hard to break down, and that proved to be true until Sandy Baltimore broke the deadlock after 28 minutes. Yet an unfortunate own goal from Lucy Bronze levelled things up almost immediately afterwards, and Chelsea were once again forced to battle through their block. While Chelsea's unbeaten run in the WSL was extended to 17 games, and we remain undefeated in all competitions this season, Bompastor took the opportunity to reflect on the draw after the game and pointed to the areas where she felt her side were below par this afternoon. 'The result is really frustrating for us,' she said. 'Today the performance was not good enough for us to get a better result. We were probably too slow. We had 20 shots on goal, eight on target, but even when we shot on target we were not clinical enough, not ruthless enough, and I don’t think we made Everton's goalkeeper work hard enough. 'Also, the connection between the players didn’t really click today. So it happens. When we have a performance like that, it’s good for us to provide feedback and to be honest and realistic about what happened on the pitch. 'In terms of the defensive aspects, today we were not compact enough as a block. We didn’t recover enough balls in terms of the high press. So that’s something we need to do better going into the next game. 'Without the ball, we conceded an unfortunate goal, but it was the goal that allowed them to get a point from this game. So it happens sometimes. As much as we are frustrated, now it’s for us to analyse the game, take the feedback, and move on to the next one.' Despite the initial disappointment of dropping points, the head coach did point to some positives to take from the game. Chelsea kept Everton to zero shots on target throughout the 90 minutes, even if we struggled to break through their low block. And with a match against Hacken to play on Tuesday night, there's no time to dwell on today's result. 'If we analyse from the beginning of the season, we had many games where we had a lot of good performances and a lot of quality on the pitch,' she continued. 'So it’s good for us when we are doing well not to go too high and when we have a frustrating result, not to go too low. Because I believe this team has a lot of quality, and we can do better than what we did today. 'Sometimes it's good not to always perform at a good level because it means you still have work to be done, and you need that. For me, it’s best when you have a frustrating result to play quickly straight afterwards. So the quick turnaround is actually a positive thing. You can quickly move on and focus on what is next.'
news.body_zh: 周六下午我们在斯坦福桥1-1战平埃弗顿，索尼娅·邦帕斯特感到沮丧，但她认为这是在周二晚上前往瑞典哈肯的女子冠军联赛之前反思和提高的机会。主教练在赛前新闻发布会上表示，太妃糖很难打破，事实证明这一点是正确的，直到桑迪·巴尔的摩在第28分钟打破僵局。然而，露西·青铜不幸的乌龙球几乎立即将比分扳平，切尔西再次被迫通过防守进行战斗。虽然切尔西在 WSL 中的不败纪录已延长至 17 场，并且我们在本赛季的所有比赛中保持不败，但 Bompastor 借此机会在赛后反思了平局，并指出了她认为今天下午球队低于标准杆的地方。 “结果对我们来说确实令人沮丧，”她说。 “今天的表现还不够好，我们无法取得更好的结果。我们可能太慢了。我们有20次射门，其中8次射正，但即使我们射中目标，我们也不够冷静，不够无情，而且我认为我们没有让埃弗顿的门将足够努力。 “此外，今天球员之间的联系并没有真正融洽。所以它发生了。当我们有这样的表现时，提供反馈并对球场上发生的事情保持诚实和现实是有好处的。 “在防守方面，今天我们的防守不够紧凑。在高位逼抢方面，我们没有收回足够的球权。所以这是我们在下一场比赛中需要做得更好的事情。 “在没有球的情况下，我们丢了一个不幸的球，但正是这个进球让他们在这场比赛中拿到了一分。所以有时会发生这种情况。尽管我们很沮丧，但现在我们需要分析游戏，获取反馈，然后继续下一场比赛。”尽管最初的失分令人失望，但主教练确实指出了从比赛中可以看到的一些积极因素。切尔西在整个 90 分钟内让埃弗顿保持零射门，即使我们很难突破他们的低位防守。周二晚上将有一场对阵哈肯的比赛，所以没有时间细想今天的结果。 “如果我们从赛季初开始分析，我们在很多比赛中都有出色的表现，并且在球场上也表现出色，”她继续说道。 “因此，当我们表现良好时，不要走得太高，当我们的成绩令人沮丧时，不要走得太低，这对我们有好处。因为我相信这支球队有很多素质，我们可以做得比今天更好。 “有时候，不总是表现出色是件好事，因为这意味着你还有工作要做，而且你需要这样做。对我来说，当你得到令人沮丧的结果时，最好是在事后立即快速比赛。因此，快速周转实际上是一件积极的事情。您可以快速继续前进并专注于下一步。”

news.title: Match report: Chelsea Women 1-1 Everton
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西女足 1-1 埃弗顿
news.body_en: With a defensive record only bettered by Chelsea in the WSL this season, the Blues knew we would be in for a tough afternoon against Everton even before the match had kicked off, and so it proved as we had to settle for a point at Stamford Bridge. After a cagey first half hour, Sandy Baltimore broke the deadlock when a small connection on the ball saw her steer home from a Lucy Bronze header back across goal. It felt like Chelsea were on our way, but when Bronze took an unfortunate touch from a looping ball in, the Toffees were back on level terms just four minutes later, and the teams went in at 1-1 at the break. Despite Everton not managing a shot on target during the match, the visitors made things really difficult for the Blues, reducing us to half-chances throughout. Their efforts were rewarded as they kept us from adding to the scoreline and took a point away from the Bridge. Sonia Bompastor made four alterations to her starting XI, swapping Veerle Buurman, Nathalie Bjorn and Sjoeke Nusken for Bronze, Kadeisha Buchanan and Erin Cuthbert. Lauren James had unfortunately been ruled out with a hamstring injury earlier in the week, and Wieke Kaptein came into the line-up in her place. The head coach had mentioned in her pre-match press conference that she expected the visitors to defend well, and that's exactly what happened in the opening stages of the game as the Toffees played in a compact formation as they attempted to negate our strengths. Our first real attempt came from one of Ellie Carpenter's trademark runs down the flank, and as she let fly with a shot, only a tiny deflection from the defender saw it bounce just wide of the right-hand post. Melvine Malard was next to go close with a header that was just off target, but the offside flag went up soon afterwards to confirm that it wouldn't have counted. It wasn't going to be easy to break Everton down, but the Blues were getting closer. After a superb one-two with Carpenter, Kaptein blasted her shot towards goal but had her attempt cleared off the line. Our opener came soon afterwards. After we took a short corner, Katie McCabe swung a cross into the back post to find the head of Bronze. The centre-back cushioned her header across the face of goal, allowing Baltimore to nod home with the slightest of touches. Yet the Toffees hit back when a looping cross from Yuka Momiki took an unfortunate touch off Bronze and deflected into the back of the net. Our number 22 almost cancelled out the own goal with a bullet header seven minutes before the break, but an impressive stop saw Everton goalkeeper Courtney Brosnan tip the attempt over the bar. After another tight opening to the second half, Bompastor made a double substitution after 55 minutes, introducing Nusken and Thompson for Baltimore and Kaptein. The clock ticked towards 70 and, other than a series of corners, the Blues were yet to put any real pressure on a resolute Everton defence. When the Blues were awarded a free-kick for a late challenge on Carpenter, McCabe took it short to Thompson just outside her, and the American laid the ball off to Walsh. The midfielder bent in a curling shot, but Brosnan was able to collect. That was the only real danger we caused in the second half as the statistics showed we fired 21 shots on goal but ended the match with only three big chances created. It was a frustrating day, but we will look to regain top spot when we face leaders Manchester City next weekend in the WSL. We drop to second in the table, two points behind leaders Manchester City, following their 5-0 win over West Ham United earlier today. We travel to Sweden to face Hacken in the Women's Champions League on Tuesday, with kick-off set for 5.45pm UK time. We will then back at Stamford Bridge for our top-of-the-table clash with Man City next Saturday. Tickets are still available and you can secure your place here. news.body_zh: 本赛季在 WSL 中，蓝军的防守记录仅次于切尔西，在比赛开始之前，蓝军就知道我们将在对阵埃弗顿的比赛中度过一个艰难的下午，事实证明，我们必须在斯坦福桥获得一分。经过谨慎的上半小时后，桑迪·巴尔的摩打破了僵局，露西·青铜的头球攻门，皮球的一个小接触让她将球带回球门。感觉切尔西已经在路上了，但当布隆兹不幸触碰到弧线球时，仅仅四分钟后太妃糖就扳平了比分，中场休息时两队以 1-1 领先。尽管埃弗顿在比赛中没有射正，但客队给蓝军制造了很大的困难，使我们整场比赛的机会减少了一半。他们的努力得到了回报，他们阻止了我们增加比分，并让蓝桥拿走了一分。索尼娅·邦帕斯特对她的首发阵容进行了四次调整，将维尔勒·布尔曼、娜塔莉·比约恩和斯乔克·努斯肯换成了青铜、卡德莎·布坎南和艾琳·库斯伯特。不幸的是，劳伦·詹姆斯在本周早些时候因腿筋受伤而缺席比赛，维克·卡普坦代替她进入了首发阵容。主教练在赛前新闻发布会上提到，她希望客队能够做好防守，而这正是比赛开局阶段发生的情况，太妃糖队以紧凑的阵型试图削弱我们的优势。我们的第一个真正的尝试来自埃莉·卡彭特标志性的侧翼跑动，当她射门时，后卫只做了一个微小的偏转，球就弹到了右侧门柱外。梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 紧接着头球攻门，但头球稍稍偏离目标，但越位旗很快就升起，确认这粒进球不算数。击败埃弗顿并不容易，但蓝军已经越来越接近了。在与卡彭特进行了精彩的二过一后，卡普坦的射门却被挡出底线。我们的揭幕战很快就到来了。在我们开出一个短角球后，凯蒂·麦凯布将一记传中球打入后门柱，找到了青铜队的头球。这名中后卫将她的头球挡在了球门前，让巴尔的摩队通过最轻微的触球就进球了。然而，太妃糖队进行了反击，来自 Yuka Momiki 的弧线传球不幸触碰了布隆兹并偏入网后。中场休息前七分钟，我们的 22 号球员几乎用一记子弹头球抵消了乌龙球，但埃弗顿门将考特尼·布鲁斯南的精彩扑救将射门高出横梁。下半场再次紧张开场后，邦帕斯特在第 55 分钟后进行了两次换人，用努斯肯和汤普森换下巴尔的摩和卡普坦。时间一分一秒地指向70分，除了一系列角球之外，蓝军还没有对埃弗顿坚决的防守施加任何真正的压力。当蓝军在最后时刻对卡彭特的挑战获得任意球时，麦凯布将球短传给了在她身旁的汤普森，美国人将球传给了沃尔什。这名中场球员射门弯曲，但布罗斯南接住了球。这是我们在下半场造成的唯一真正的危险，因为统计数据显示我们射门 21 次，但最终只创造了 3 次绝佳机会。这是令人沮丧的一天，但下周末我们在 WSL 中面对领头羊曼城时，我们将寻求重新夺回榜首位置。在今天早些时候 5-0 战胜西汉姆联队后，我们跌至积分榜第二位，落后领头羊曼城两分。我们将于周二前往瑞典，在女子冠军联赛中迎战哈肯，开球时间定于英国时间下午 5 点 45 分。然后我们将回到斯坦福桥，参加下周六对阵曼城的积分榜榜首比赛。门票仍然有售，您可以在这里预留席位。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、青铜、布坎南、麦凯布、库斯伯特（c）（比弗-琼斯 74）、沃尔什、卡普坦（努斯肯 55）、巴尔的摩（汤普森 55）、松久保（波特 HT）、马拉德（德拉戈尼 84）未上场替补：彭、比约恩、布尔曼、哈野进球者：巴尔的摩28 埃弗顿：布罗斯南（中）、布伦德尔、石川、莱泽尔、惠勒、范古尔（加利 90）、喜多川、卡博特、莫木（穆雄 84）、梅斯、帕切科未上场替补：福斯特-因曼、凯恩、兰塔拉、芬尼根、加贺扎-西尔科克得分：铜牌 OG 32

news.title: U18 Premier League Cup report: Chelsea Under-18s 3-1 Charlton Under-18s
news.title_zh: U18英超联赛杯战报：切尔西U-18队3-1查尔顿U-18队
news.body_en: Chelsea Under-18s are through to the quarter-finals of the U18 Premier League Cup following a 3-1 victory over Charlton Athletic. Andrew Pennie won us a spot-kick which Jashayde Greenwood coolly converted to give us the lead. Greenwood returned the favour 14 minutes later, setting up Pennie’s goal which put us back in front after Charlton’s Jayden Twum equalised in the 28th minute. The Blues pushed for a third in the second 45 minutes and our persistence soon told as we earned and converted another penalty through Greenwood. In the first half it was all Chelsea and it didn’t take long for us to take the lead. Pennie was played through on the left wing with two defenders still to beat. He cut inside, drawing a foul from the Charlton defender, leaving the referee with no choice but to point to the penalty spot. Greenwood stepped up to take and made no mistake, going hard and low into the bottom right corner while sending the goalkeeper the wrong way. The visitors responded with a goal of their own, as Twum managed to get half a yard on Jacob Hall before tucking the ball into the far corner. We regained the lead quickly, as Greenwood became the creator and Pennie the goalscorer. The former received the ball and opted to drive down towards the byline; he then cut his pass across the face of goal to Pennie, who thumped the ball against the crossbar and in to make it 2-1 before the break. After the interval, we came racing out the blocks once more, aiming to extend our advantage to ensure our spot in the last eight. We enjoyed the best opportunities of the half through Heze Grimwade and Kwamina Ampah. First, Grimwade was played through one-on-one with the goalkeeper by Greenwood but dragged his shot wide. Minutes after coming on Ampah was presented with the golden chance to settle the match as Gabriel Sambou dinked a cross into the penalty area, but Ampah’s shot was off target. Charlton put some pressure on us too, but we handled the heat well and stood firm. Josh Henry in particular denied the visitors another equaliser with two lunging challenges to turn goal-bound efforts out for a corner. The Blues eventually got their third, and it was from the spot once again as Greenwood remained composed to net his brace. We earned the penalty when Emmanuel Ayinde headed Grimwade’s cross towards goal, only to be denied by the hand of Raynon Richman. Greenwood elected for a different spot-kick approach this time; he stuttered and waited for Williams to move before smashing his strike into the opposite corner. This win means that we are through to the knockout stages of the Under-18 Premier League Cup. Chelsea Under-18s host Arsenal in the Under-18 Premier League on Saturday 21 November at Cobham Training Ground. The game gets underway at 11am GMT and supporters can watch the match live with a CFC+ subscription. news.body_zh: 切尔西U-18队以3-1战胜查尔顿竞技队，晋级U18英超杯四分之一决赛。安德鲁·佩尼为我们赢得了一个点球，贾沙伊德·格林伍德冷静地主罚命中，为我们带来领先。 14分钟后，格林伍德回敬一球，助攻彭尼的进球，查尔顿队的杰登·特乌姆在第28分钟扳平比分，让我们重新领先。蓝军在接下来的 45 分钟内力争第三个点球，我们的坚持很快就得到了体现，我们赢得了格林伍德的另一个点球并罚进了点球。上半场全是切尔西，没过多久我们就取得了领先。佩尼在左翼被突破，仍有两名防守队员需要击败。他内切，造成查尔顿后卫犯规，裁判别无选择，只能指向点球点。格林伍德挺身而出，没有犯任何错误，他大力低射入球右下角，同时将门将送出错误的方向。客队用自己的进球做出了回应，特乌姆成功地距离雅各布·霍尔半码，然后将球塞入远角。我们很快重新取得领先，格林伍德成为创造者，彭尼成为进球者。前者接到球后选择向底线冲去；后者则选择向底线冲刺。随后他将球传给了佩尼，后者将球击中横梁，在中场休息前将比分改写为2-1。中场休息后，我们再次冲出赛区，旨在扩大优势，确保进入八强。我们通过菏泽格里姆瓦德和夸米纳安帕享受了上半场最好的机会。首先，格里姆韦德被格林伍德与门将进行一对一的射门，但他的射门偏出。上场几分钟后，安帕获得了决定比赛胜负的绝佳机会，加布里埃尔·桑布将球传入禁区，但安帕的射门偏出目标。查尔顿也给我们带来了一些压力，但我们很好地应对了高温并保持了稳定。尤其是约什·亨利，他两次奋力冲刺，将客队的射门化为角球，阻止了客队再次扳平比分。蓝军最终获得了第三个进球，这也是格林伍德保持冷静并梅开二度的结果。当伊曼纽尔·艾因德（Emmanuel Ayinde）头球攻向格里姆韦德（Grimwade）的传中球门时，我们赢得了点球，但被雷农·里奇曼（Raynon Richman）挡出。格林伍德这次选择了不同的点球方式。他结结巴巴地等待威廉姆斯移动，然后将球击入对面的角落。这场胜利意味着我们已经进入了U-18英超联赛杯的淘汰赛阶段。 11 月 21 日星期六，切尔西 18 岁以下青年队在科巴姆训练场举行 18 岁以下英超联赛，主场迎战阿森纳。比赛将于格林威治标准时间上午 11 点开始，支持者可以通过 CFC+ 订阅观看比赛直播。切尔西（4-3-3）：托比·贝尔； Riley Ebho (Emmanuel Ayinde 78)、Josh Henry、Jacob Hall (C)、Isago Silva (Gabriel Sambou 77)； Isaac Badu、Jayden Malundama（Rico Sealey 82）、Isaac McGillvary； Heze Grimwade、Jashayde Greenwood、Andrew Pennie (Kwamina Ampah 67)未使用的替补：Aaron Woolford、Jack Anderson、Eliah Semakula得分手：Greenwood 21、89、Pennie 35黄牌：Malundama 45+1、Pennie 58经理：Dan Hogan 查尔顿竞技队（4-3-3）：Logan Williams、Theo Laronde、卡梅伦·里德、哈里·兰德尔（中）、米哈伊尔·西蒙斯； Takudzwa Muvhuti (Patrick Boje 82)、Edward Thomas、Kacper Podgorny； Zaion Christian、Jayden Twum (Kayode Peterkin 57)、Raynon Richman未使用的替补：Finley Lapper、Noah Grover-Smith、Kit Fleming得分手：Twum 28预订：Richman 89经理：Jason Pearce

news.title: Penders on learning quickly, that Mbeumo save and dreaming big
news.title_zh: 渴望快速学习、姆博莫拯救并梦想成真
news.body_en: By his own admission, Mike Penders has experienced a ‘rollercoaster of emotions’ during his start to life between the posts at Chelsea. It is to his credit how he has handled the ups and downs thrown at him so far. Penders started the season as our number two, behind Emiliano Martinez in the pecking order. He made his Blues debut in the Carabao Cup victory over Luton Town in August and started the next round, too, as Leeds United were beaten 6-3. But the tall Belgian was thrust into the spotlight when Martinez sustained a nasty jaw injury midway through the second half of our Premier League game at Everton. Penders helped see out the clean sheet, making a positive first impression in the English top flight. However, the following weekend, it was Penders’ own goal that set Tottenham on their way to a rare victory at Stamford Bridge. That mistake was a test of the 21-year-old’s nerve, but his response was emphatic. He put in two stellar performances against Liverpool and Manchester United, with several saves plucked from the very top drawer. There is certainly plenty for Penders to reflect on as he sits down at Cobham ahead of our trip to Sunderland this weekend. ‘Right now I feel very good,’ he says. ‘It’s been a rollercoaster of emotions as well, but now I’m very happy I could react positively in the last two games. ‘When it comes to pressure, I try to stay as relaxed as possible. And then, of course, mistakes happen. You think about them, that’s normal, but I try to turn it into something positive. I try to learn about it. I like to look at the videos to see what I could do better, and then move on. ‘It was a learning moment, and outside of the mistake, I felt okay during the game. The most important thing was to have a positive reaction in the next couple of games, and I’m happy I could bring that.’ Penders benefitted from having his whole family in attendance at the Tottenham game. Afterwards, they offered support, of course, but were also able to take his mind off it by changing the subject when required. Penders also felt the love from his team-mates and his manager, Xabi Alonso. ‘He spoke very positively about me during interviews, which gave me a lot of confidence to go into the next game. Also, my defenders and some of the other players came up to me and just spoke with me. I appreciated that a lot. ‘You don’t forget these kinds of things, you know? The players who come up to you, write you a little message: "Keep your head up, keep going.” It means a lot.’ Any goalkeeper plays on the margins. A small error can be brutally punished. On the flip side, a pivotal save can preserve three points. It comes with the territory. Just seven days after his own goal, Penders made such a brilliant stop it has been nominated for the Premier League Save of the Month award. You can vote for Mike’s improbable fingertip stop from Bryan Mbeumo’s rasping volley here. It was a save so good that it needed multiple replays and camera angles to prove Penders had actually got a decisive touch on the ball. He reveals it was a source of mirth among his team-mates afterwards. ‘The ball came so quickly, I didn’t even see it properly,’ says Penders. ‘It was just instinct, pure instinct; a reaction. I felt a good touch on my fingertips, and after that moment, I screamed all the positive emotions out. I had to. I was so happy with that moment. ‘Then, after the game, no-one believed me that I touched it! I was like, “Yeah, I touched it; you will see afterwards”. ‘Then it was pretty quickly on Twitter. A team-mate came into the dressing room saying: “He touched it”. I was very happy it was a good angle because if the angle wasn't right, they could still have some doubts!’ Mike Penders' reaction time 🤯🔵 @ChelseaFC pic.twitter.com/5aXNDl8zwd Penders is flattered by comparisons to his compatriot Thibaut Courtois, which serve as motivation to work even harder. His focus now is on trying to write his own story and make a name for himself. He knows one way to do that is to learn from those around him. Martinez – ‘a very good guy’ – has already proven to be a huge help, and there are certain elements of the Argentinean’s game that Penders is trying to implement in his own, as he sees fit. Combine those Cobham learnings with invaluable Premier League experience and you sense Penders’ trajectory is rising. It gives him hope he can realise his ambitions, even if he knows there is a long way to go. ‘I have a lot of dreams...a lot of dreams. I hope I can win as many trophies as possible with the club. ‘The big dream? I think that would be winning the Champions League or winning a World Cup with my country, something like that. And then maybe go for the biggest individual prizes. ‘These are dreams that are far away, but you want to work towards them. This is the start of the journey.’
news.body_zh: 迈克·潘德斯自己承认，在切尔西的职业生涯初期，他经历了“情绪的过山车”。值得赞扬的是，他如何应对迄今为止所面临的起起落落。彭德斯在赛季开始时是我们的第二号球员，排在埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯之后。他在八月份战胜卢顿镇的卡拉宝杯比赛中首次亮相蓝军，并在下一轮比赛中首发出场，最终利兹联以6-3击败。但当马丁内斯在我们对阵埃弗顿的英超联赛下半场中途严重受伤时，这位身材高大的比利时人成为了人们关注的焦点。彭德斯帮助球队完成零失球，在英格兰顶级联赛中给人留下了积极的第一印象。然而，在接下来的周末，正是彭德斯的乌龙球帮助热刺在斯坦福桥取得了罕见的胜利。这个错误考验了这位 21 岁球员的勇气，但他的反应很坚决。他在对阵利物浦和曼联的两场比赛中都有出色的表现，并在顶级球队中做出了几次扑救。在我们本周末前往桑德兰之前，当彭德斯坐在科巴姆时，肯定有很多值得思考的事情。 “现在我感觉很好，”他说。 “这也是情绪的过山车，但现在我很高兴我能在过去两场比赛中做出积极的反应。 “当谈到压力时，我会尽量保持放松。然后，当然，错误就会发生。你想到它们，这很正常，但我试着把它变成积极的东西。我尝试了解一下。我喜欢看视频，看看我可以做得更好，然后继续前进。 “这是一个学习的时刻，除了错误之外，我在比赛中感觉还不错。最重要的是在接下来的几场比赛中取得积极的反应，我很高兴我能做到这一点。” 彭德斯因全家人一起观看托特纳姆热刺的比赛而受益匪浅。随后，他们当然提供了支持，但也能在需要时改变话题，让他不再去想这件事。彭德斯还感受到了队友和主教练哈维·阿隆索的爱。 “他在采访中对我的评价非常积极，这给了我参加下一场比赛的信心。另外，我的后卫和其他一些球员也走到我身边并与我交谈。我非常欣赏这一点。 ‘你不会忘记这些事情，知道吗？向你走来的球员会给你写一条小信息：“抬起头来，继续前进。”这意义重大。”任何守门员都在边缘踢球。一个小错误可能会受到残酷的惩罚。另一方面，关键的扑救可以保住三分。它随领土而来。就在他进球的第七天后，彭德斯做出了如此精彩的扑救，被提名为英超联赛本月最佳扑救奖。你可以在这里投票支持迈克在布莱恩·姆博莫的刺耳截击中不可思议的指尖停球。这次扑救非常出色，以至于需要多次重播和摄像机角度来证明彭德斯实际上对球起到了决定性的作用。他透露，这是赛后他的队友们欢笑的源泉。 “球来得太快了，我什至没有看清它，”彭德斯说。 “这只是本能，纯粹的本能；一个反应。我感觉到指尖有一种很好的触感，在那一刻之后，我把所有积极的情绪都喊了出来。我不得不这么做。那一刻我非常高兴。 ‘然后，比赛结束后，没有人相信我碰过它！我当时想，“是的，我摸过它；之后你就会看到”。 “然后这件事很快就在推特上流传开来。一名队友走进更衣室说：“他碰了它”。我很高兴这是一个很好的角度，因为如果角度不对，他们仍然可能会有一些疑问！’迈克·彭德斯的反应时间🤯🔵@ChelseaFC pic.twitter.com/5aXNDl8zwd 与他的同胞蒂博·库尔图瓦相比，彭德斯感到受宠若惊，这成为更加努力工作的动力。他现在的重点是尝试写自己的故事并为自己扬名。他知道做到这一点的一种方法就是向周围的人学习。马丁内斯——“一个非常好的人”——已经被证明是一个巨大的帮助，而彭德斯正试图以他认为合适的方式将阿根廷人比赛中的某些元素运用到自己的比赛中。将科巴姆的经验与宝贵的英超经验结合起来，你会感觉到彭德斯的轨迹正在上升。这给了他实现自己抱负的希望，即使他知道还有很长的路要走。 “我有很多梦想……很多梦想。 我希望我能和俱乐部一起赢得尽可能多的奖杯。 ‘伟大的梦想？我认为这将是赢得欧洲冠军联赛或与我的国家一起赢得世界杯，类似的事情。然后也许会争取最大的个人奖项。 “这些梦想虽然遥远，但你想为之努力。这是旅程的开始。

news.title: Confirmed Chelsea Women line up vs Everton
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西女足对阵埃弗顿的阵容
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has made four changes to her Chelsea side for our Women's Super League match against Everton at Stamford Bridge this afternoon. Following our 6-0 win against Charlton last Sunday, Bompastor had almost a week to prepare for today's home match against Everton. The head coach has switched up her backline, exchanging Nathalie Bjorn and Veerle Buurman for Lucy Bronze and Kadeisha Buchanan. Captain Erin Cuthbert starts in midfield in place of Sjoeke Nusken, while Wieke Kaptein comes in for Lauren James, who sustained a hamstring injury at The Valley last weekend and has been ruled out until the end of the current block of fixtures. Summer signing Manaka Matsukubo retains her place in the side after making her first start for the Blues against Charlton. Chelsea: Hampton, Carpenter, Bronze, Buchanan, McCabe, Cuthbert (c), Walsh, Kaptein, Baltimore, Matsukubo, Malard Chelsea substitutes: Peng, Bjorn, Buurman, Potter, Nusken, Dragoni, Hamano, Thompson, Beever-Jones
news.body_zh: 今天下午在斯坦福桥对阵埃弗顿的女足超级联赛比赛中，索尼娅·邦帕斯托对她的切尔西队做出了四项调整。继上周日我们以 6-0 战胜查尔顿之后，邦帕斯托花了将近一周的时间来准备今天主场对阵埃弗顿的比赛。主教练对后防线进行了调整，将娜塔莉·比约恩和维尔勒·布尔曼换成了露西·青铜和卡德伊沙·布坎南。队长艾琳·库斯伯特（Erin Cuthbert）取代索克·努斯肯（Sjoeke Nusken）在中场首发，而维克·卡普坦（Wieke Kaptein）顶替劳伦·詹姆斯（Lauren James），后者上周末在山谷中腿筋受伤，一直缺席本轮比赛。夏季签约的松久保真中在对阵查尔顿的比赛中首次代表蓝军首发后，保留了她在球队的位置。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、青铜、布坎南、麦凯布、库斯伯特（中）、沃尔什、卡普坦、巴尔的摩、松久保、马拉德切尔西替补：彭、比约恩、布尔曼、波特、努斯肯、德拉戈尼、滨野、汤普森、比弗-琼斯

news.title: Key talking points from Sonia Bompastor's pre-Everton press conference
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托在埃弗顿赛前新闻发布会上的主要谈话要点
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor faced the media at Cobham ahead of our Women's Super League clash against Everton on Saturday, and here are the key talking points from what the Blues head coach said. We remain unbeaten this season after 13 matches, but Bompastor assured that the standard of preparation will be as high as always as we head into our fifth WSL game of the campaign at Stamford Bridge. The head coach reported that Lauren James will be missing until the end of this block of matches before the international break, after a scan confirmed that she sustained a hamstring injury during the 6-0 win over Charlton last weekend. Lexi Potter, meanwhile, is available again. Here are the rest of the key talking points from our head coach’s pre-match press conference on Friday. 'My role is to make sure that when we are in good form, we don't go too high. And sometimes when things are not going the way we want, we don't go too low either. I'm responsible for that. 'Right now, of course, we are happy with the results and most of the performances we are having on the pitch, but we won't change anything. We keep working hard, we keep the same mentality, we train with intensity, and we come into every game as well prepared as we can. 'That's what we need to do. Every game in this league is so important and so difficult, so we need to make sure we sustain that for as long as possible.' 'It's always difficult to score goals against any team. The difference maybe in the Charlton game was that we scored early on the game, and we were winning 4-0 after 19 minutes. And when you are really efficient and clinical from the beginning, it changes the whole game. 'Going into the game tomorrow, we are expecting it might not be possible for us to achieve. They are a really difficult team to break down, and we will have to play at our best if we want to get a result from the game. We'll try our best to break them down, to score as early as possible in the game and to see how they react. 'They haven't conceded many goals, and they are an aggressive team, but in a good way. They had a good result against Manchester United, so I'm sure they are coming in with confidence as well. We are very much aware of the threats and the quality this Everton side has, especially in terms of the defensive aspects.' 'It's really important to be hungry. The hunger is part of the mentality and the mindset a team have, and that's what makes the difference between the good teams and the great teams, the ones who are able to win trophies. 'Sometimes you don't always play the best football, but you always find a way to win games, and that's really important. We focus a lot on the quality of the performance we want to put on the pitch, but some days it's not always possible for different reasons. We need to make sure when those days come, we have that hunger and that mentality to turn things around even when it's not the way we want to play.' 'Ellie has been starting her actions higher up the pitch for sure, and also she probably feels more freedom to attack. She's been working really hard in training sessions, and she stays at the end to do some extra work around finishing in the box, crosses, the quality of the crosses, scanning, and the quality of her first touch. 'She's always keen to work hard, and she always asks for extras. She's been doing that from the beginning of the season, and it's paying off, so it's good for her.' 'Everyone could see that it was Lucy (Bronze). She was really good at scaring people. She got me, but she also got most people in the team. But it was really nice. 'We work really hard most of the time, and we spend so much time focusing on every detail. We speak a lot about our ambitions, how we want to perform on the pitch, and we are professional, so we do that one hundred per cent. 'But it's also good when you can find a good balance and have good laughs and some fun. At the end of the day, football is a game, and when your team is able to play at their best, it's when players have fun on the pitch.' See the Blues in action against Everton at Stamford Bridge tomorrow! Tickets are available here...
news.body_zh: 周六，我们的女足超级联赛对阵埃弗顿之前，索尼娅·邦帕斯托在科巴姆接受了媒体采访，以下是蓝军主教练所说的关键谈话要点。本赛季我们在 13 场比赛后保持不败，但 Bompastor 保证，当我们在斯坦福桥进入本赛季第五场 WSL 比赛时，准备工作的水平将一如既往地高。主教练报告说，劳伦·詹姆斯将缺席到国际比赛日之前的这组比赛结束，此前扫描证实她在上周末 6-0 战胜查尔顿的比赛中腿筋受伤。与此同时，莱克西·波特又可以上场了。以下是我们主教练周五赛前新闻发布会上的其余关键谈话要点。 “我的职责是确保当我们状态良好时，我们不会走得太高。有时，当事情没有按照我们想要的方式发展时，我们也不会走得太低。我对此负责。 “当然，现在我们对结果和我们在球场上的大部分表现感到满意，但我们不会改变任何事情。我们继续努力，我们保持同样的心态，我们进行高强度的训练，我们在每场比赛中都做好了充分的准备。 '这就是我们需要做的。这个联赛中的每场比赛都如此重要且如此困难，所以我们需要确保我们尽可能长时间地维持这一点。” “对阵任何球队进球总是很困难。与查尔顿的比赛的不同之处可能在于我们在比赛初期就取得了进球，并且在 19 分钟后我们以 4-0 获胜。当你从一开始就真正高效、冷静时，整个游戏就会改变。 “进入明天的比赛，我们预计我们可能无法实现这一目标。他们是一支非常难以击败的球队，如果我们想从比赛中获得结果，我们就必须发挥出最好的水平。我们会尽力击垮他们，在比赛中尽早得分，看看他们的反应。 “他们没有丢很多球，他们是一支积极进取的球队，但方式很好。他们在对阵曼联的比赛中取得了不错的成绩，所以我相信他们也会充满信心。我们非常清楚埃弗顿队的威胁和实力，特别是在防守方面。” “饥饿确实很重要。渴望是球队心态和心态的一部分，这就是优秀球队和伟大球队、能够赢得奖杯的球队之间的区别。 “有时候你并不总是能踢出最好的足球，但你总能找到赢得比赛的方法，这非常重要。我们非常注重我们想要在球场上表现的质量，但有时由于不同的原因这并不总是可行。我们需要确保当那些日子到来时，我们有那种渴望和心态来扭转局面，即使这不是我们想要的比赛方式。” “埃莉肯定已经在球场上开始了她的行动，而且她可能感觉更自由地进攻。她在训练中一直非常努力，她会留在最后，围绕禁区射门、传中、传中质量、扫描和第一次触球质量做一些额外的工作。 “她总是热衷于努力工作，而且总是要求额外的东西。她从赛季一开始就这么做了，现在已经得到了回报，所以这对她有好处。” “每个人都可以看出那是露西（铜牌）。她确实很擅长吓唬人。她得到了我，但她也得到了团队中的大多数人。但这真的很好。 “我们大部分时间都非常努力地工作，我们花了很多时间关注每一个细节。我们经常谈论我们的抱负，我们希望如何在球场上表现，而且我们很专业，所以我们百分百做到这一点。 “但当你能找到良好的平衡、开怀大笑和享受乐趣时，这也是件好事。”归根结底，足球是一项运动，当你的球队能够发挥出最佳状态时，球员们就能在球场上享受乐趣。”明天看蓝军在斯坦福桥对阵埃弗顿的比赛！门票可以在这里购买...

news.title: Alonso wants Chelsea focused on the pitch, not the table
news.title_zh: 阿隆索希望切尔西专注于球场，而不是桌子
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso insists it is still much too early to be reading anything from the Premier League table, both in terms of his Chelsea team’s progress and the quality of opponent we will face against Sunderland. The Blues head to the Stadium of Light for our next Premier League fixture, taking on Sunderland in a 2pm kick-off on Sunday. A quick glance at the league table would suggest the two teams go into the game in very different fortunes. With three wins from our four Premier League matches since the last international break, Chelsea sit fourth in the table, with a chance to move up to third this weekend. Meanwhile, the Black Cats are stuck in the bottom spot, with just one league win to their name in 2026/27. However, our manager insisted he isn’t thinking about the league table at this stage of the campaign, when asked in his pre-match press conference if Chelsea’s position was a sign of our progress so far this season under his leadership. ‘The table means not too much because that can change so much in one week, in two games,’ Alonso pointed out. ‘We are taking a step forward, I think, with the ball, against the ball, being more solid. ‘We have a tough opponent, a tough visit to Sunderland, we know what it takes to win there. We know how demanding it will be. ‘The table doesn’t matter. I think that they deserve more points than they’ve got and it's going to be a tough away game.’ Instead, it is the task of building the consistency and momentum needed to be challenging in the upper reaches of the Premier League come May which is taking up Alonso and his team’s attention. That continues at Sunderland on Sunday, when the Blues will attempt to follow up last week’s 2-0 victory over Manchester United by making it back-to-back wins in the Premier League. ‘As I've said, it’s early days to talk too much about the table. We won the last game, now the focus is to keep winning, winning, winning and to build this mentality to go game by game. ‘We are expecting a tough game on Sunday against a team that do many good things. They should have more points probably and it is not going to be easy, for sure.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索坚称，现在从英超积分榜上解读任何信息都还为时过早，无论是从切尔西队的进步还是我们将在对阵桑德兰的对手的实力方面来看。蓝军将前往光明球场参加下一场英超联赛，他们将在周日下午 2 点迎战桑德兰。快速浏览一下联赛表就会发现，两支球队在比赛中的命运截然不同。自上次国际比赛日以来，切尔西在四场英超比赛中取得三场胜利，目前排名第四，本周末有机会升至第三。与此同时，黑猫队则陷入垫底位置，2026/27赛季只取得一场联赛胜利。然而，当我们的主教练在赛前新闻发布会上被问及切尔西的排名是否是我们本赛季在他的领导下取得进步的标志时，他坚称在赛季的这个阶段他并没有考虑联赛积分榜。阿隆索指出，“积分榜并没有多大意义，因为在一周内、两场比赛中，情况可能会发生很大变化。” “我认为，我们正在向前迈出一步，无论是持球还是对抗球，都更加稳固。 “我们有一个强大的对手，对桑德兰的访问很艰难，我们知道如何才能在那里获胜。我们知道这将是多么苛刻。 ‘桌子并不重要。我认为他们应该得到比现在更多的积分，这将是一场艰难的客场比赛。”相反，阿隆索和他的球队的注意力集中在建立在五月份的英超联赛上游挑战所需的一致性和动力上。这种情况将于周日在桑德兰继续进行，届时蓝军将试图继上周2-0战胜曼联之后，在英超联赛中取得背靠背胜利。 “正如我所说，现在谈论太多桌子还为时过早。我们赢了上一场比赛，现在的重点是继续赢球、赢球、赢球，并建立这种心态去一场场比赛。 “我们期待周日对阵一支做了很多好事的球队进行一场艰难的比赛。他们可能应该获得更多积分，但这肯定不会容易。

news.title: Sunderland vs Chelsea: All you need to know
news.title_zh: 桑德兰 vs 切尔西：你需要知道的一切
news.body_en: With almost a quarter of the Premier League campaign completed, fourth-placed Chelsea travel to the Stadium of Light. Club historian Rick Glanvill and club statistician Paul Dutton look ahead to Sunday's 2pm kick-off against Sunderland. It will be the Blues’ first appearance in this time slot since our 4-3 beating of Brighton & Hove Albion and is a consequence of the Black Cats’ UEFA Europa League involvement on Thursday. Ebullient when Chelsea lost 2-1 there in May, Sunderland supporters are nervy in November, with five losses in six league outings and no three-point haul since August. As the final international break of 2026 looms, they lie bottom of the Premier League pile, two points from safety with the second-worst goal difference in the division. For their Europa League game in midweek, Regis Le Bris rotated six of the 11 who started last weekend’s 3-1 loss to fellow relegation fighters Coventry City. Previously unbeaten in the competition, they lost 2-0 at home to Dinamo Zagreb. Meanwhile, Xabi Alonso’s team had a free midweek to rest and prepare, following Saturday's second-half 2-0 dismantling of Manchester United, and will rise to third with a win on Wearside, should Brighton fail to beat Brentford. Speaking in his pre-match press conference, Alonso revealed that he will make a late decision on Sunday to determine if Moises Caicedo and Emiliano Martinez have recovered sufficiently to feature against Sunderland. Jorrel Hato, Maxence Lacroix and Joao Pedro remain unavailable until at least the end of the forthcoming international break. ‘On Saturday we have our last training session before Sunday and we will decide,' Alonso replied when asked about Martinez. 'But he is training well. It is very good that Emi has made a great effort to be back and is ahead of the plan to be part of the team. So we will check and then on Sunday we will take the final decision. ‘Moi had little problems after the last game, so we expect to check on Saturday on different situations and he is one of them.' It may surprise Chelsea fans scarred by historic cup losses at Sunderland to hear that the Blues have a decent league record there. We have won 34 per cent of our 61 trips to this part of the North-East, just four fewer than our 38 per cent success rate at Tottenham Hotspur. Even before Roker Park closed its turnstiles in 1997, Chelsea had enjoyed sporadic success there, including a classic 2-0 victory in which Mickey Thomas scored from the spot soon after the restart and Kerry Dixon sealed the points late on. That was the first time we had ever won at Roker by two or more goals and remains our joint-biggest margin of victory at Sunderland. A run of just one top-flight defeat and no draws against the Black Cats between 2002 and 2013 weighs in heavily on that wins statistic, and the sole loss in that run came at Stamford Bridge. The spree of nine straight wins at the Stadium of Light included two memorably high-scoring clashes. A goalless first half did not foretell what was to happen after the break there on the last day of the 2008/09 season, a week before Guus Hiddink’s men would beat Everton in the FA Cup final. Nicolas Anelka broke the deadlock early in the second half with a spectacular drive from distance (to secure the Golden Boot), before Kieran Richardson made Petr Cech pay for a rare mishandling. The game swung again when Salomon Kalou lashed into the corner and Ashley Cole netted his second for the club to make it 3-1.  In the last minute, Kenwyne Jones pulled another one back for the relegation-threatened Wearsiders, and news filtered through that Newcastle United had lost to Aston Villa and would suffer the drop instead. Two years later, in February 2011, Phil Bardsley’s solo effort struck an early blow for the hosts, but minutes later Ahmed Elmohamady fouled Cole and Frank Lampard equalised from 12 yards. Anelka then pounced on a loose ball to feed Kalou, who edged Carlo Ancelotti’s defending champions ahead for the first time. The Black Cats kept scrapping and Richardson fired a free-kick through the Blues’ wall to send the two teams in level at the break. Chelsea continued to pepper Craig Gordon’s goal and when the keeper parried Lampard’s lashed shot, John Terry forced it home.  Before the final whistle, Anelka struck to seal an impressive 4-2 victory. Our most recent win at the home of the Mackems came in mid-December 2016, under Antonio Conte. The league leaders remained top over Christmas for the fifth time in the Premier League, thanks to Cesc Fabregas’ swept finish. Following his success against Manchester United, Cole Palmer has scored 19 of his 21 Premier League penalties for Chelsea. Only Frank Lampard (41 from 48) has managed a higher total. Romeo Lavia won possession 14 times during Saturday’s win, the most by any Chelsea player in a Premier League game since Lewis Hall against Fulham in January 2023 (also 14). Alonso’s side are outperforming the expected goals (13.34) metric by +5.56 (19 goals), the second best in the Premier League, while Sunderland are underperforming theirs (13.21) by -6.21, the second-worst performers. Chelsea have won 54.7 per cent of ground duels, the highest rate in the top flight. Only five teams have a lower pass completion rate this season than Sunderland (78.8 per cent). Chelsea (six) have found the net more times from set-plays in the league than any rival except Brighton (seven). The Blues (53) have managed the most shots on target in the Premier League, but also sustained the most by opponents (50). The Black Cats have not won at home in the top flight on this date since 1932, when they beat Grimsby 3-2. A year earlier, in a 2-0 defeat at Roker Park, Chelsea fielded our oldest-ever starting XI, averaging 31 years and 336 days.
news.body_zh: 随着英超联赛接近四分之一的比赛结束，排名第四的切尔西将前往光明球场。俱乐部历史学家里克·格兰维尔和俱乐部统计学家保罗·达顿展望周日下午 2 点对阵桑德兰的比赛。这将是蓝军自 4-3 击败布莱顿以来首次在这个时间段出场，也是黑猫队周四参加欧洲联赛的结果。 5 月份切尔西 1-2 输给桑德兰时，桑德兰的支持者们热情高涨，而 11 月份桑德兰的支持者们则紧张不安，他们在六场联赛中输掉了 5 场，而且自 8 月份以来就没有取得过三分。随着 2026 年最后一场国际比赛日的临近，他们在英超联赛中排名垫底，距离安全区还差两分，净胜球排名联赛第二差。在周中的欧罗巴联赛中，雷吉斯·勒布里斯轮换了 11 名首发球员中的 6 名，上周末球队以 3-1 输给了保级战队考文垂城。此前在各项赛事中保持不败的球队在主场0-2不敌萨格勒布迪纳摩。与此同时，哈维·阿隆索的球队在周六下半场2-0击败曼联后，在周中得到了休息和准备的时间，如果布莱顿未能击败布伦特福德，他们将在威尔赛德获胜后升至第三位。阿隆索在赛前新闻发布会上透露，他将在周日晚些时候做出决定，以确定莫伊塞斯·凯塞多和埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯是否已经恢复到足以参加对阵桑德兰的比赛。乔雷尔·哈托、马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦和若昂·佩德罗至少在即将到来的国际比赛日结束之前都无法上场。 “周六我们将在周日之前进行最后一次训练，我们会做出决定，”当被问及马丁内斯时，阿隆索回答道。 “但他训练得很好。很高兴 Emi 为回归做出了很大的努力，并且提前加入了团队。所以我们会进行检查，然后在周日做出最终决定。 “上一场比赛后莫伊没有遇到什么问题，所以我们希望在周六检查不同的情况，他就是其中之一。”因杯赛历史性输给桑德兰而伤痕累累的切尔西球迷听到蓝军在那里拥有不错的联赛战绩可能会感到惊讶。在我们前往东北部这一地区的 61 场比赛中，我们赢得了 34% 的胜利，仅比托特纳姆热刺 38% 的成功率少了四场。甚至在 1997 年罗克公园关闭十字转门之前，切尔西就已经在那里取得了零星的成功，其中包括一场经典的 2-0 胜利，米基·托马斯在比赛重新开始后不久就点球破门，克里·迪克森在比赛后期锁定了分数。这是我们第一次在对阵罗克的比赛中以两个或更多的进球获胜，并且仍然是我们在桑德兰的比赛中并列最大的胜利优势。 2002 年至 2013 年间，球队在顶级联赛中只输给了黑猫队一次，并且没有取得平局，这对胜利统计数据产生了重大影响，而那场比赛中唯一的失利是在斯坦福桥。光明球场的九连胜包括两场令人难忘的高得分比赛。上半场没有进球并没有预示2008/09赛季最后一天中场休息后会发生什么，一周前希丁克的球队将在足总杯决赛中击败埃弗顿。尼古拉斯·阿内尔卡在下半场一开始就以一记精彩的远距离射门打破了僵局（确保了金靴奖），随后基兰·理查森让切赫为罕见的处理不当付出了代价。比赛再次出现逆转，所罗门·卡劳射入角球，阿什利·科尔打进第二球，帮助俱乐部将比分改写为3-1。最后一分钟，肯维恩·琼斯为面临降级威胁的韦尔赛德队再下一城，消息传出纽卡斯尔联队输给了阿斯顿维拉，将降级。两年后，即 2011 年 2 月，菲尔·巴德斯利 (Phil Bardsley) 的个人射门为东道主队带来了早早的打击，但几分钟后艾哈迈德·埃尔莫哈马迪 (Ahmed Elmohamady) 对科尔犯规，弗兰克·兰帕德 (Frank Lampard) 在 12 码处扳平比分。随后阿内尔卡扑向一个松散的球，将球喂给卡劳，卡劳首次将安切洛蒂的卫冕冠军领先。黑猫队继续拼抢，理查森任意球穿过蓝军人墙，中场休息时两队打成平手。切尔西继续对克雷格·戈登的进球进行攻击，当门将挡出兰帕德的猛射时，约翰·特里将球强行破门。终场哨响前，阿内尔卡破门，以4-2锁定胜局。我们最近一次在 Mackems 主场取得胜利是在 2016 年 12 月中旬，在安东尼奥·孔蒂 (Antonio Conte) 的带领下。 得益于法布雷加斯的横扫，联赛领头羊在圣诞节期间第五次在英超联赛中保持领先地位。继对阵曼联的比赛中取得成功后，科尔·帕尔默在代表切尔西踢进的 21 个英超点球中打进了 19 个。只有弗兰克·兰帕德（48 球中的 41 球）的总进球数更高。罗密欧·拉维亚在周六的比赛中赢得控球权 14 次，这是自 2023 年 1 月刘易斯·霍尔对阵富勒姆的比赛中（同样是 14 次）以来，切尔西球员在英超比赛中获得控球权最多的球员。阿隆索的球队比预期进球数（13.34）高出+5.56（19个进球），在英超联赛中排名第二，而桑德兰队的表现比预期进球数（13.21）低-6.21，是表现第二差的球队。切尔西在地面对抗中获胜率为 54.7%，是顶级联赛中最高的。本赛季只有五支球队的传球完成率低于桑德兰（78.8%）。切尔西（六次）在联赛中定位球进球次数比除布莱顿（七次）之外的任何对手都多。蓝军（53 次）是英超联赛中射正次数最多的球队，同时也是被对手挡住球门次数最多的球队（50 次）。自1932年以3-2击败格里姆斯比以来，黑猫队还没有在这一天在顶级联赛主场获胜。一年前，在罗克公园球场以 2-0 击败切尔西的比赛中，切尔西派出了队史年龄最大的首发阵容，平均年龄为 31 岁零 336 天。

news.title: Xabi Alonso delivers latest on Caicedo and Anselmino fitness
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索介绍凯塞多和安塞尔米诺的最新健身情况
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has issued an update on the fitness of Moises Caicedo and Aaron Anselmino ahead of this weekend’s Premier League trip to Sunderland. The Blues manager confirmed earlier today (Friday) in his pre-match press conference that he will wait until after our final session tomorrow to make a call on Caicedo, who was absent from training earlier this week. Alonso said the Ecuadorian was feeling discomfort because of ‘little problems’ in the wake of our victory over Manchester United. He has, however, confirmed Caicedo has been out on the grass at points this week. ‘He’s doing bits and other bits,’ said Alonso, reiterating that a decision will be made on the 25-year-old's fitness after the final training session. Alonso has positive news on Anselmino, who has been called up to the Argentina national squad alongside Emiliano Martinez and Valentin Barco. The defender has yet to make his Chelsea debut, but there is a possibility that could change this weekend at the Stadium of Light. ‘He’s doing everything, and tomorrow [Saturday] we’ll decide, but he could be in the squad, yes,' said Alonso. 'They (Argentina) asked us and he has been training better for the last ten days, and it’s very important for him have this first call-up.'
news.body_zh: 在本周末前往桑德兰的英超联赛之前，哈比·阿隆索发布了莫伊塞斯·凯塞多和亚伦·安塞尔米诺的最新健康状况信息。蓝军主帅今天（周五）早些时候在赛前新闻发布会上证实，他将等到明天最后一场训练结束后才给凯塞多打电话，凯塞多本周早些时候缺席了训练。阿隆索表示，在我们战胜曼联后，厄瓜多尔人因为“小问题”而感到不舒服。然而，他证实凯塞多本周曾多次缺席草地。 “他正在做一些事情，”阿隆索说道，并重申将在最后一次训练后根据这位 25 岁球员的健康状况做出决定。阿隆索对安塞尔米诺有好消息，他与埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯和瓦伦丁·巴尔科一起被征召入阿根廷国家队。这名后卫尚未在切尔西首次亮相，但本周末在光明球场的比赛有可能发生变化。 “他正在做一切，明天（周六）我们会做出决定，但他可能会进入球队，是的，”阿隆索说。 “他们（阿根廷）要求我们，他在过去十天里训练得更好，这对他来说第一次征召非常重要。”

news.title: Xabi Alonso: Every player will have their moment
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索：每个球员都会有属于自己的时刻
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso is certain that every member of his Chelsea squad will make an impact on the team over the course of this season, believing it is key to make sure every player understands their next opportunity is never far away. Speaking in his pre-match press conference at Cobham on Friday, ahead of our Premier League trip to Sunderland, Alonso was asked whether it was challenging to manage his squad when every player is eager to play as big a role in the team as possible. The Spaniard’s side has seemed settled at times so far this season, but there are always tweaks to be made depending on our game plan and next opponent. Our manager was also quick to point out that the changing nature of form and fitness means any player’s next chance to stake a claim could be right around the corner at any time. ‘There are moments when a player feels that he's far from the pitch, but actually he's not that far,’ explained Alonso. ‘It's about having the opportunity. Everyone will have their moment. ‘We have seen it and we will see it happening again, because of the situations that we are having dealing with injuries in certain positions, some positions more than others. In the end, in the long run, you will see that everyone will play their role.’ Two examples the Blues manager pointed to are Estevao Willian and Wesley Fofana, who both started last week’s 2-0 win over Manchester United in the absence of Joao Pedro and Maxence Lacroix, who remain unavailable for the trip to the Stadium of Light. In the case of Estevao, Alonso felt it was an important moment for the young winger to come into the team and perform well, twice being unlucky to be denied a goal by narrow VAR calls against the Red Devils. ‘It was very good for him, for the team, that he had such an impact,’ our manager continued. ‘We had taken the decision and he knew that was going to be the game, and it was very important for him, that game, and for the team as well.’ Xabi also highlighted the growing maturity shown by Fofana, which he in part attributes to the 25-year-old becoming a father. Our French defender recovered from some first-half errors against Man Utd to play a key role in the brilliant second-half performance that secured all three points, earning praise for his mentality and resilience. ‘It's about dealing with difficult moments and he did many good things,' Alonso added. 'For sure, the mistakes, he knew and he reacted really well. The second half he was solid, he was reliable, as he was in Liverpool. ‘He's already been in the Premier League for years. He's been at this club for four years. It's part of the job to deal with some things that are not what you want, to deal with mistakes, to deal with difficult situations. ‘I'm seeing now Wes is very focused this year. He's mature - he's had his baby, so it's making him more mature - as well as taking more responsibility on the pitch. Sometimes he’s not direct, but sometimes that helps as well. So we support him and he's important.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索确信他的切尔西队的每一位成员都会在本赛季对球队产生影响，他相信确保每名球员都明白他们的下一个机会永远不会遥远是关键。周五，在我们前往桑德兰的英超联赛之前，阿隆索在科巴姆举行的赛前新闻发布会上发表讲话，被问及当每个球员都渴望在球队中发挥尽可能重要的作用时，管理他的球队是否具有挑战性。本赛季到目前为止，西班牙人的球队有时似乎已经稳定下来，但根据我们的比赛计划和下一个对手，总会有一些调整。我们的经理也很快指出，状态和健康状况的变化意味着任何球员的下一次夺冠机会随时可能就在眼前。 “有时候，球员会觉得自己离球场很远，但实际上他并没有那么远，”阿隆索解释道。 ‘这是关于拥有机会。每个人都会有属于自己的时刻。 “我们已经看到了这种情况，而且我们还会看到这种情况再次发生，因为我们正在处理某些位置的伤病情况，有些位置比其他位置受伤的情况更多。最后，从长远来看，你会看到每个人都会发挥自己的作用。”蓝军主教练指出的两个例子是埃斯特沃·威廉和韦斯利·福法纳，他们在上周2-0战胜曼联的比赛中首发出场，而若奥·佩德罗和马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦仍然无法参加光明球场的比赛。就埃斯特沃而言，阿隆索认为，对于这位年轻边锋来说，这是一个重要的时刻，让他进入球队并表现出色，在对阵红魔的比赛中，他两次不幸被VAR吹罚进球无效。 “他产生了如此大的影响力，这对他、对球队来说都非常好，”我们的主教练继续说道。 “我们已经做出了决定，他知道这将是一场比赛，这对他、那场比赛以及球队来说都非常重要。”哈维还强调了福法纳所表现出的日益成熟，他将这部分归功于这位 25 岁的年轻人成为了父亲。我们的法国后卫在对阵曼联的比赛中从上半场的一些失误中恢复过来，并在下半场的精彩表现中发挥了关键作用，最终全取三分，他的心态和韧性赢得了赞誉。 “这是为了应对困难时刻，他做了很多好事，”阿隆索补充道。 “当然，他知道这些错误，而且他的反应非常好。下半场他很稳定，他很可靠，就像他在利物浦时一样。 “他已经在英超踢球很多年了。他在这个俱乐部已经呆了四年了。处理一些不想要的事情、处理错误、处理困难的情况是工作的一部分。 “我现在看到韦斯今年非常专注。他很成熟——他已经有了自己的孩子，所以这让他更加成熟——同时也在球场上承担了更多的责任。有时他并不直接，但有时这也有帮助。所以我们支持他，他很重要。”

news.title: Bompastor delivers injury update on Lauren James and Lexi Potter
news.title_zh: 邦帕斯特发布了劳伦·詹姆斯和莱克西·波特的伤情最新消息
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has confirmed that Lauren James sustained a hamstring injury against Charlton, but there was more positive news about the fitness of Lexi Potter. The Blues sit top of the table following our 6-0 victory over Charlton last weekend, and are currently ahead of rivals Manchester City in second place on goal difference. The only disappointment for Chelsea fans during that emphatic win was that Lauren James was forced off with an injury after 35 minutes, with Erin Cuthbert drafted in to replace her as a substitute. And after having a full week to assess James' fitness, the head coach was able to give an update on her injury. 'LJ will be missing the games until the end of the block,' explained Bompastor. 'She had a scan, and she has an injury in her hamstring. We won’t see her on the pitch until the end of this block. 'Of course, we know how good Lauren is for us, for the team. My job is to make sure I find solutions when players are not available. The good thing is that I looked at some of the statistics we saw from last week, and we are a team who can score with different players. 'A lot of players were involved in the scoring against Charlton, and every player on the pitch had a shot on goal. Even if it was not always a great one, at least all of the players on the pitch had a shot on goal. That's a good thing. My job is to make sure I now find the solutions without LJ on the pitch.' Midfielder Lexi Potter missed out on the Charlton win with a small knee injury sustained against Roma in our 2-0 Women's Champions League victory, but has been training with the squad this week, as Bompastor explained. She said: 'We have Lexi Potter who is back in the squad and in contention for the game.' See the Blues in action against Everton at Stamford Bridge tomorrow! Tickets are available here...
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特证实劳伦·詹姆斯在对阵查尔顿的比赛中腿筋受伤，但关于莱克西·波特的健康状况还有更多积极的消息。蓝军在上周末6-0战胜查尔顿后稳居积分榜榜首，目前以净胜球优势领先于排名第二的对手曼城。在这场大获全胜的比赛中，唯一令切尔西球迷失望的是劳伦·詹姆斯在第 35 分钟后因伤被迫下场，艾琳·库斯伯特替补上场。在花了整整一周的时间评估詹姆斯的健康状况后，主教练能够提供有关她伤势的最新信息。 “LJ 将缺席比赛直到本赛季结束，”邦帕斯特解释道。 “她做了扫描，发现她的腿筋受伤了。直到这个街区结束我们才会在球场上看到她。 “当然，我们知道劳伦对我们、对球队来说有多好。我的工作是确保在球员无法上场时找到解决方案。好消息是，我看了上周我们看到的一些统计数据，我们是一支可以与不同球员一起得分的球队。 “很多球员都参与了对阵查尔顿的进球，场上的每个球员都有射门机会。即使这并不总是一场伟大的比赛，至少球场上的所有球员都有射门的机会。这是一件好事。我的工作是确保我现在能在 LJ 不在场的情况下找到解决方案。”在我们2-0战胜罗马的女足欧冠比赛中，中场球员莱克西·波特因膝部轻微受伤错过了查尔顿队的胜利，但正如邦帕斯特解释的那样，她本周一直在随队训练。她说：“我们有莱克西·波特，他回到了球队并争夺比赛资格。”明天看蓝军在斯坦福桥对阵埃弗顿的比赛！门票可以在这里购买...

news.title: Xabi Alonso confirms Chelsea team news for Sunderland
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索确认了切尔西队桑德兰队的消息
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso says a decision on Emi Martinez's availability to face Sunderland will be taken tomorrow (Saturday), with the Blues manager also updating on the fitness of Moises Caicedo, Jorrel Hato, Maxence Lacroix and Joao Pedro. After defeating Manchester United at Stamford Bridge last time out, the Blues are on the road this weekend as we make the long journey to Wearside to face a Sunderland side that have won one of their nine top-flight matches this season. Alonso will oversee our final pre-match training session tomorrow at Cobham, after which he will decide who starts against the Black Cats. One choice he may have to make is who starts in goal. Martinez has been sidelined since our win at Everton, after which he underwent jaw surgery, but has returned to training this week wearing protective headgear. ‘Tomorrow we have our last training session before Sunday and we will decide [if he is fit],' Alonso replied when asked about Martinez in his pre-match press conference. 'But he is training well.’ In Martinez's absence, Mike Penders has started our last three matches. And Alonso accepts he may face a difficult decision about who starts between the posts at the Stadium of Light. ‘All the decisions are tough, in all the positions. It is very good that Emi has made a great effort to be back and is ahead of the plan to be part of the team. So, tomorrow we will check and then on Sunday we will take the final decision.’ Alonso will also wait until after tomorrow's session to make a call on the fitness of Moises Caicedo, who was absent from training earlier in the week at Cobham. The Blues manager said: ‘He had little problems after the last game, so we expect to check tomorrow on different situations and Moi is one of them. It’s a discomfort, more than his calf.’ Three players who will definitely be absent this weekend are Hato, Lacroix and Joao Pedro, and Alonso stated that the trio will be assessed over the international break. ‘He isn’t fit yet,' Alonso said on Hato. 'It will take some more weeks. Not yet to be close, maybe after the international break but it’s going to take longer. 'After these two weeks of the international break, we will see how their recovery is and the progress they make. For sure, ahead of the Leeds game, I will have more of an update. But not today.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索表示，明天（周六）将决定埃米·马丁内斯能否对阵桑德兰，蓝军主帅还将更新莫伊塞斯·凯塞多、乔雷尔·哈托、马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦和若昂·佩德罗的健康状况。上次在斯坦福桥击败曼联后，蓝军本周末将踏上客场之旅，我们将长途跋涉前往威尔赛德，迎战桑德兰队，他们已经赢得了本赛季九场顶级联赛中的一场比赛。阿隆索明天将在科巴姆监督我们最后的赛前训练，之后他将决定谁在对阵黑猫队的比赛中首发。他可能必须做出的一个选择是由谁首发进球。自从我们战胜埃弗顿以来，马丁内斯就一直缺席比赛，之后他接受了下颌手术，但本周他戴着防护帽重返训练。 “明天我们将在周日之前进行最后一次训练，我们将决定（他是否健康），”阿隆索在赛前新闻发布会上被问及马丁内斯时回答道。 “但他训练得很好。”在马丁内斯缺席的情况下，迈克·潘德斯首发了我们的最后三场比赛。阿隆索承认他可能会面临一个艰难的决定，决定谁在光明球场首发。 “无论在哪个位置，所有的决定都是艰难的。很高兴 Emi 为回归做出了很大的努力，并且提前加入了团队。因此，明天我们将进行检查，然后周日我们将做出最终决定。阿隆索还将等到明天的训练结束后，对莫伊塞斯·凯塞多的健康状况进行评估，他本周早些时候缺席了科巴姆的训练。蓝军主帅表示：“上一场比赛后他几乎没有什么问题，所以我们希望明天检查不同的情况，莫伊就是其中之一。”哈托、拉克鲁瓦和若昂·佩德罗这三名肯定缺席本周末的球员，阿隆索表示，这三人将在国际比赛日期间接受评估。 “他还没有恢复健康，”阿隆索在谈到哈托时说道。 '这还需要几周的时间。尚未接近，也许在国际比赛日之后，但需要更长的时间。 “在这两周的国际比赛日之后，我们将看到他们的恢复情况以及取得的进展。当然，在与利兹联的比赛之前，我会有更多的更新。但今天不行。”

news.body_en: Ticket sales information for our last game before Christmas has now been confirmed. Chelsea host Aston Villa in our Premier League meeting at Stamford Bridge on Monday 21 December, kick-off 8pm. Home tickets for members for men’s team matches are allocated through an application process. For each home match, eligible members have a designated application window during which they can apply for tickets. Applications can be made individually or as a group, provided all members of the group are eligible to apply during that window. Tickets will be allocated one per person with a maximum of four per application. Ticket application window opens – Monday 9 November 12pm Ticket application window closes – Thursday 12 November 12pm The ticket application window will be open for True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue and Junior Blue members. As part of the verification process, a pre-authorisation charge of £0.01 will be applied to validate your payment card. No money will be taken at this stage, and the hold will be removed by your provider. Tickets for this match are priced at Category A. Please click here for match ticket prices Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event. Eligible members can submit their application through the official ticketing portal at any time during the window; supporters must ensure they are logged in to successfully apply. Applying earlier does not increase the likelihood of success, giving supporters greater flexibility to apply at a time that suits them. Members who are eligible for concession-rate tickets are automatically assigned their price class. To ensure you are receiving the correct ticket, please take the time to check that the date of birth on your account is accurate. You will only be allocated tickets in your selected areas unless you choose to be considered for other available options. If you only wish to be entered for tickets in one area of the stadium, please leave the second option blank. Please read the ticket application information carefully before submitting your application. Successful and unsuccessful applications will be notified by email within four working days of the ticket application window closing date. Successful applications will be charged to their payment card at approximately this time. Supporters are not able to use account credit for ticket application window purchases. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend with and sit next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over. Click for ticket office opening times Click for Frequently Asked Questions Members and season ticket holders can purchase Westview tickets for Premier League home games via the Chelsea FC Official Ticketing Portal. A maximum of four tickets can be bought per person, and only the ticket purchaser is required to be a member or season ticket holder. You are not required to be a member or season ticket holder to purchase non-Westview Club Chelsea packages. Club Chelsea tickets are non-refundable unless the match is cancelled, postponed, or moved more than 48 hours either side of the scheduled fixture date. All Club Chelsea ticket purchases are subject to Club Chelsea terms and conditions. For any further Westview enquiries, please email clubchelsea@chelseafc.com. Loyalty points are awarded for attendance at men’s first-team home matches. Points will be added to eligible accounts following each game, provided the ticket has been scanned at the turnstile. This means that eligible members purchasing tickets on the ticket exchange, or receiving tickets via ticket forwarding, receive loyalty points for attending matches. Supporters will receive three loyalty points for attending this match. Supporters who require accessible tickets can apply through the accessible ticket application window. Timings are below: Accessible ticket application window opens - Monday 9 November 12pm Accessible ticket application window closes – Thursday 12 November 12pm Supporters, if they are able to do so, can call our Access Team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers) for any questions or if they need further information.
